newsitem.title: JAPAN: G7 statement reflects Japan view on forex - govt.
newsitem.headline: G7 statement reflects Japan view on forex - govt.

text.p: A statement issued at the end of the weekend meeting of the Group of Seven (G7) industrial nations reflected Japan's opinion on foreign exchange rates, Japan's top government spokesman said on Monday.

The G7 agreed that economic fundamentals should be reflected in foreign exchange rates, and that an excessively weak yen or wild fluctuations in exchange rates were not favourable, Chief Cabinet Secretary Seiroku Kajiyama told a news conference.
Finance ministers and central bank governors from the G7 agreed at a meeting in Berlin on Saturday to try to stabilise the dollar.
